forward_assignment: Exact maximum-weight one-to-one matching of routing logits at every adaptive forward; no feature mixing
surrogate_backward: H + (Sinkhorn(logits, temperature) - stop_gradient(Sinkhorn(logits, temperature))); biased straight-through gradient
selection: Minimum original-BN validation CE at epochs 40 through 50, identically to the reused random control
bn_refit: Identical frozen layer-wise training-only population estimator for both selected models; no weight updates
primary_comparison: Learned minus fixed-random held-out calibration accuracy after the same BN refit
scope: One-seed controlled feasibility pilot; no sweep, compression or official-test inference. Extra training variables/compute are reported. A positive gate is only motivation for replication, not evidence of a general gain or novelty.
